context_for_next_testing_agent: Custody Portal feature fully implemented and tested. The portal allows external parties (attorneys, courts) to view evidence chain of custody using secure time-limited access tokens. Token-based access without user authentication. Access tokens are created by evidence owners and can be shared with attorneys/courts. Tokens have expiration times and access levels (view, download, full). All backend endpoints working correctly. Frontend Share Custody dialog and Custody Portal page working correctly.

api_endpoints: GET /api/custody-portal/download-court-package?token= - downloads court package (public, requires download/full access)
frontend_pages: /custody-portal - Public portal page with token input
/evidence - Share Custody button on evidence cards
